bugs.cause: NearbyScanner.create() returns null when Bluetooth is off; onResume uses it with !!.
bugs.fix: Handle the null scanner: say Bluetooth is off (and disable Scan) instead of starting it.

bugs.signature: ANR in dev.liveview.testbench (Input dispatching timed out)
bugs.cause: scanNow() blocks up to 12 s waiting for the full scan, and PairingActivity calls it on the main thread.
bugs.fix: Run the full scan off the main thread (a callback or a thread in scan()) and post the result.

bugs.cause: A typo in the string resource.

bugs.signature: E/Settings: Couldn't load the settings, java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "12s"
bugs.cause: Durations are stored as "12s" (the default and save()), but parseSeconds() expects a plain number.
bugs.fix: parseSeconds() drops the trailing "s" (value.trim().removeSuffix("s").toInt()); a unit test for "12s".

bugs.signature: E/DeviceRepository: Couldn't open the icon for …, java.io.FileNotFoundException: …/filesicons/….png
bugs.cause: The icon folder's path is built without a separator (files + icons = filesicons); IconCache writes them to files/icons.

bugs.signature: I/Devices: Showing 24 devices after about 5000 ms (the use case allows 2 s)
bugs.cause: The comparator measures both devices' signal (30 ms each) on every comparison: about 100 comparisons.
bugs.fix: Measure each device once, then sort: all().map { it to signalStrength(it) }.sortedByDescending { it.second }.map { it.first }.

bugs.cause: The name thread copies `details` before its wait and writes the copy back after it, losing a battery level written meanwhile.
bugs.fix: Read and update `details` together after the wait, under a lock or on the main thread (runOnUiThread { details = details.copy(...) }).
